The model is an FT-Transformer (per-feature tokenizer with categorical embeddings and continuous linear projections, learnable CLS token, positional embeddings, TransformerEncoder with 3 layers/8 heads, GELU FFN, CLS-based classification head) trained with label-smoothed BCE, AdamW, warmup+cosine LR schedule, mixup, and gradient clipping.
